2607.14816.title: Large Language Models for Code Generation from Multilingual Prompts: A Curated Benchmark and a Study on Code Quality
2607.14816.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform differently on identical programming tasks when prompted in different natural languages, a phenomenon known as language bias. While this behavior has been widely studied for general text generation, its impact on code generation quality and programming conventions remains largely unexplored. We investigate how the language used to describe programming tasks affects the source code generated by GPT-4o mini, DeepSeek, and Claude. Our study comprises 460 coding tasks spanning Python (230) and Java (230). We translate and manually curate the original English prompts into Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, and Italian while preserving their technical meaning. We evaluate the generated code using multiple dimensions, including functional correctness through test pass rates, structural quality using established code metrics, issues detected by static analysis tools, and lexical characteristics such as the language used in identifiers and comments. Our results show that (i) English prompts do not consistently produce the best functional correctness or code quality, (ii) the impact of prompt language depends on both the programming language and the LLM, and (iii) generated code frequently mixes English with the prompt language in comments and string literals. These findings provide the first curated multilingual benchmark for studying language bias in code generation and offer insights for developing more robust multilingual code generation systems.
2607.14816.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在不同自然語言提示下執行相同的程式設計任務時表現不同，這種現象稱為語言偏見。雖然這種行為在一般文本生成方面已被廣泛研究，但其對程式碼生成質量和程式設計規範的影響仍然未被充分探索。我們研究了描述程式設計任務所使用的語言如何影響GPT-4o mini、DeepSeek和Claude生成的源代碼。我們的研究包括460個編碼任務，涵蓋Python（230個）和Java（230個）。我們將原始的英文提示翻譯並手動整理成中文、印地語、西班牙語和意大利語，同時保留其技術意義。我們使用多個維度評估生成的代碼，包括通過測試通過率的功能正確性、使用既定代碼指標的結構質量、靜態分析工具檢測到的問題，以及標識符和註釋中使用的語言等詞彙特徵。我們的結果顯示：（i）英文提示並不總是產生最佳的功能正確性或代碼質量，（ii）提示語言的影響取決於程式語言和LLM，及（iii）生成的代碼在註釋和字串文字中經常混合使用英文和提示語言。這些發現提供了首個經過整理的多語言基準，用於研究程式碼生成中的語言偏見，並為開發更強健的多語言程式碼生成系統提供了見解。
